## ICreateProgramOptions.libFileProvider property

Optional lib file provider.

**Signature:**

```typescript
libFileProvider?: ILibFileProvider;
```

## Remarks

If not provided, lib files must be available in the virtual filesystem at their expected locations (e.g., /lib/lib.d.ts).
